artworks.title: Queen Christina
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a portrait, facing slightly to her right with a gaze towards the viewer. She has a long face, a prominent nose, and full lips, along with long wavy hair falling to her shoulders. She is wearing a gown with a low neckline, detailed around the bust area with lace or intricate stitching, and accessorized with a brooch and cross-lacing. She is also wearing a string of pearls or a beaded necklace. The portrait is within an oval frame, set against a background of closely spaced vertical lines. Below the image, there is text identifying the woman and the publisher.

artworks.title: Christina, Queen of Sweden
artworks.description: This engraving depicts a portrait of a woman from the chest up within an ornate oval frame. She has a composed expression and detailed facial features, and her hair is styled with waves and adorned with a headpiece resembling a small crown. She wears an elaborate garment with a lace-trimmed collar, structured bodice, and puffed sleeves, along with an intricate necklace. The frame is decorated with floral and vegetal motifs, and two cherubs are depicted at the top corners. The background is obscured by decorative elements. Below the portrait is an inscribed plaque with Latin text.

artworks.title: Prince Christopher, son of Anthony, King of Portugal
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a mustache, chin beard, and curly hair styled back. He wears a high-collared shirt with a ruff and a richly decorated garment. The background features a lined oval and Latin text.

artworks.title: Ciconia (Paschalis)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man in a seated position, with his hands clasped together in front of him. He has a stern expression, a full beard, a mustache, and a sharp nose. He is wearing an ornate hat and a richly decorated cloak. The background features Latin text, a cherubic figure holding a book, and additional text below the portrait. The focus is on the detailed rendering of the subject and surrounding elements.

artworks.title: Clara Maria, Duchess of Brunswick, Wife of August II
artworks.description: The image depicts a person's upper body within an ornate oval frame. The person faces forward with a round face and soft features, styled hair with curls. They wear an elaborate garment with a detailed lace collar and an ornate necklace. The background features a border with classical motifs like cherubs and figures reading a book. Text is inscribed around and below the portrait.

artworks.title: Pope Clement VIII
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man shown from the chest upwards. He is positioned facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a beard and mustache, with defined facial features, including a prominent nose and wrinkles on his forehead. He is wearing a cap and a robe that is buttoned at the front. He holds an open book in front of him. The engraving is set within an oval frame inscribed with text, and there are additional decorative elements around it, such as keys and a papal tiara. The background outside the oval consists of a plain field, and the image is printed on a textured sheet of paper with various inscriptions.

artworks.title: Pope Clement VIII
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the chest upwards, facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. He has a serious expression, a neatly trimmed beard, and a mustache. He wears a cap on his head and a buttoned robe with a fur-lined collar. Surrounding him is an oval frame with text. To the right, there is an open book. The background features intricate patterns and symbols, including a papal tiara and keys.

artworks.title: Pierre le Clerc, Doctor of Theology in Paris
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, capturing him from the chest upwards. He is facing slightly to the right with a solemn expression, wearing a skullcap on his head. The man has prominent eyebrows, a narrow nose, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His clothing includes a dark, textured robe with a high, buttoned collar featuring small ruffles. The background is plain, emphasizing the man's features and attire.

artworks.title: Philip Cluver, Geographer
artworks.artist: Workshop of Crispijn van de Passe I
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper, mounted to another sheet of paper
artworks.description: This is a portrait of Philippus Cluverius, showing his upper torso and head. He is facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. Cluverius has a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, curly hair swept back, and is wearing a dark garment with a large ruffle collar. The background is dark and textured, outlined by a lighter rectangular frame. Below the portrait, the inscription reads "Philippus Cluverius, Geographus."

artworks.title: Jeannes de Cocesme, First Wife of Francois, Prince of Conti
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a woman seated, facing forward. Her facial features are delicately depicted with slightly arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, and a subtle smile. Her hair is elegantly styled, swept back and piled into a high bun. She wears a detailed gown with a high lace collar adorned with multiple rows of pearls, and the dress features intricate embroidery patterns. Her earrings are pearl drops. Surrounding her is a simple, textured background, framing the portrait in an oval with engraved text detailing her identity as Jeanne de Coesme, Princesse de Conty. The lower section of the print contains poetic French text.

artworks.title: Sir Aston Cockain, Poet
artworks.description: The image depicts a half-body engraving of a man on a stylized pedestal. He is facing slightly to his right, showing a profile view of his facial features. He has prominent cheekbones, a pointed nose, and a mustache. His hair is wavy and medium in length, falling just above his shoulders. He wears a laurel wreath on his head and draped clothing resembling historical attire. A banner with partly legible text is at the base of the pedestal. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Sir Edward Coke, Knight, Lord Chief Justice
artworks.description: The image displays a man from the waist up, seated and oriented slightly to the left. He has a mustache and beard, deep-set eyes, and a prominent nose. He wears a black cap and a large ruff collar, along with a heavy gown embellished with details. There is a decorative chain or collar around his neck. The background is neutral and dark, with an oval frame surrounding the portrait.

artworks.title: Lady Mary Coke, Wife of Edward, Viscount Coke
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a turned position facing the right. She has a calm expression and a delicately styled updo with a headdress or veil. She wears a ruffled choker and an elaborate gown with puffed sleeves and a wide sash. She is holding a broom and is near a harpsichord with open music sheets. There is a large ornate chair and a column in the background. The setting appears to be a grand interior with soft shadows.

artworks.title: John Colet, Dean of Saint Paul's
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the chest up, positioned in a side profile facing left. He has a prominent nose, high cheekbones, and an expressionless face with slight focus in his eyes. His hair is covered by a soft hat that fits snugly on his head, possibly a cap or a turban-like headpiece. He is wearing a garment that appears to be a robe or tunic, suggested by the broad drapery depicted in the engraving. The background is a textured pattern typical of an engraved representation. Below the portrait, there is a caption with text including the name "IOANNES COLETUS" and additional script in Latin.

artworks.title: Louise de Coligny, Fourth Wife of William I of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with a calm expression. Their face has prominent eyes and a small mouth, framed by tight curls and a headpiece. They wear a high-collared outfit with a ruff and a large bow. The background features intricate patterns and inscriptions.

artworks.title: Petrus Collins
artworks.description: The image portrays a man from the chest up, slightly angled to his right but facing forward. He has an elongated face, a full beard, a mustache, wavy hair parted to the side, and is wearing a dark garment with a large lace collar. His left hand is raised to chest level, holding a painting tool. He stands in front of an ornate oval frame with baroque details, including cherubic figures. The background features cross-hatched shading typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Petrus Collins
artworks.description: The image shows an older man's upper body in a three-quarter view. He has a distinct mustache and beard, groomed hair, and is dressed in a 17th-century outfit with a large white ruff collar. He holds a writing quill in his right hand and his left hand rests near an ornate inkwell. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with decorative motifs and Latin text on the outer area. The style of the portrait is engraved with detailed linework.

artworks.title: Christopher Columbus
artworks.description: The image features a historical portrait of a man in a bust format displayed within an ornamental oval frame. The man's head and shoulders are depicted facing forward with a somber expression. His features include droopy eyelids and furrowed brows. He has curly, shoulder-length brown hair and is wearing a rounded hat, along with a robe and garment with a wide collar and square neckline. Intricate floral and geometric patterns adorn the frame, with Latin inscriptions on banners above and below the oval. The background includes detailed designs of flora and mythical creatures.

artworks.title: Captain Thomas Coram
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man with his left side facing slightly toward the viewer. His face is angular with prominent eyebrows and a long, solemn expression. He has voluminous, curly white hair that falls to his shoulders. The man is dressed in 18th-century attire, wearing a dark coat with large buttons and an elaborate collar, beneath which is a vest and a white cravat. The background is a dark, neutral shade. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held by the man. The portrait has a border at the bottom displaying text that identifies him as Captain Thomas Coram.

artworks.title: Francisco Cornaro
artworks.artist: John Smith after Charles d' Agar
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the chest up, facing forward with a direct gaze. He has curly hair, a classical facial structure, and is dressed in historical formal attire. He is framed by a dark oval background and there is text near the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: R. P. Francis Coster
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man facing forward, showing his head and upper body. The man appears aged with a prominent nose, gentle eyes, a white beard, and thinning hair. He is wearing a tall hat, a dark robe, and a white collar. The background has a textured pattern, and there is a caption at the bottom identifying the person as Francis Costers, along with additional text and a signature.

artworks.title: Abraham Cowley
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person in profile view, showing their head and shoulders. The individual has distinct facial features like an upturned nose, full lips, and long, wavy hair that falls on their shoulders. They are wearing a textured garment with a detailed collar showing at the neckline. The background is dark, and the portrait is enclosed in an oval border with Latin text. Surrounding the oval border are rectangular inscriptions which may attribute the artwork or provide context.

artworks.title: Thomas Cranmer, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man facing forward. He has a long beard and wears a hat. His expression is neutral. He is dressed in a robe with a fur collar. The background has horizontal lines. At the bottom, there is text and a Latin inscription.

artworks.title: Thomas Cranmer
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man. He is depicted from the waist up, facing sideways towards the viewer. The man has long, straight hair and a full beard covering his chest. He is wearing a cap tied with a cord, and a fur-lined robe. The background features a simple, textured pattern, with detailed clothing and facial features. At the bottom of the image, there is an inscription related to the person depicted.
